entries.title: A card helps you finish setting up a Mac that runs work
entries.body: The moment another Mac, or another user on this Mac, joins to run work, a card lists what it still needs: a subscription of its own, its own GitHub sign-in, and a project to run. Each row has a button that opens that step in Settings, the rows tick off as you go, and the card goes away by itself once the Mac is set up. A task for a Mac with no sign-ins now waits and starts by itself once you sign it in, and a project on GitHub set to run on a Mac without its own GitHub sign-in asks for that sign-in before anything fails.

picture.alt: The card Finish setting up Running as Builder, listing a subscription of its own, its own GitHub sign-in and a project that runs there, with Add a subscription, Sign in to GitHub and Choose a project buttons
